name: SegWit
summary: Segregated Witness (BIP-141/143/144/145) separated transaction signatures (witness data) from the transaction data, fixing transaction malleability and effectively increasing block capacity to ~4MB. Activated via miner signaling (BIP9) and UASF (BIP148) after the block size wars.
summaryZh: 隔离见证（BIP-141/143/144/145）将交易签名（见证数据）与交易数据分离，修复了交易可延展性问题，并将区块容量有效提升至约4MB。在区块大小战争后，通过矿工信号（BIP9）和用户激活软分叉（BIP148）激活。
